title: Talk by Experts - AJAY KUMAR GARG ENGINEERING COLLEGE

blocks.text: Mental Health and Emotional Well-being Talk by an expert

The college had organised a Mental Health and Emotional Well-being talk by an expert ( Clinical Psychologist) for class-4 employees of the college on 28 Aug 2025. About 100 plus class 4 employees of the college participated in the talk and availed the benefits of the expert advice . Ms Jyotsna Sodhi, Clinical Psychologist from the company “Your DOST" conducted the session on Mental Health and the session was quite interactive. The class-4 employees had various queries and had expressed a great interest in availing the services of such an expert on Mental Health.
2 day workshop on Communication Maestro held on March 10–11, 2025

Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College, Ghaziabad, successfully hosted a two-day workshop, “Communication Maestro," on March 10–11, 2025. Led by Mr. Varun Chamadiya, Founder and Chief Educator of PROACTIVE 'I', the workshop offered an immersive learning experience centered on dynamic, real-world communication challenges.

The sessions focused on key aspects of effective communication, including conflict resolution, trust restoration, managing high-pressure conversations, and rapid-response communication challenges. With an interactive and hands-on approach, participants gained practical strategies to enhance decision-making, adaptability, and interpersonal communication.

The workshop was graced by the esteemed presence of Dr. R. K. Agarwal (Director General), Dr. Hemant Ahuja (Director) and attended by Heads of Departments, Section In-Charges, and faculty members from various departments. A total of 88 participants actively engaged in the sessions, making it a highly impactful and enriching experience.

To support continued learning, follow-up sessions and online resources will be made available, enabling participants to further refine their communication skills and effectively apply the strategies in both professional and personal settings.
